normalization.rule: Perprofile/perframe pooled signed median over native samples with1.5<=abs(frameoffset)<=3, requiring>=20finite native samples separately in EACHflank and positive pooledmedian. No fitted background/continuum or line model.
normalization.missing: Zero nativeleft/right coverage is explicitly MISSING_LEFT/RIGHT_FLANK_COVERAGE; lowfinitecounts are separate. Insufficient/nonpositive reference keeps raw-only arrays and blocks normalizedRMS. No flank movement, sign flip, shrink or extrapolation.
